status: COMPLETE for the rendered scope. This is a draft for the owner, who writes the reading of record; it carries no landing verdict.
scope: Light macOS 27, WebGPU, standard profiles at 1x and 2x: 208 three-column sheets and 80 now-only sheets (recorded and probe cells with no pre-W41 capture). RT and IC were not captured in G2, and neither was the CSS tier, so example 12 (the RT policy control) is withdrawn. Canonical holdout was not opened.
method: Direct viewing of the committed example PNGs (examples/), plus scratch nearest-neighbour crops of the bodies (x2 or x3, ΔE panels re-amplified x2 to x4) that are not evidence. No browser. Numbers beside the eye: canonical-inventory.json distances, and body-texture*.json (texture.py).

readings.observation: Photo, 1x, the known risk. Native's body is a smooth, saturated gradient: lavender top left, pink bottom left, green to yellow right. Pre-W41 washes it out; the right-hand green reads grey-olive, and its ΔE carries a broad bright band on the right. Now (E3) restores native's saturation and hue placement, and the broad band is gone. But the whole body carries a cellular texture at the backdrop's period, a blotchy pattern of darker and lighter patches that native's smooth body lacks. In the colour panel it shows as faint clouding in the upper half. The same cellular texture is in pre-W41's ΔE on the left half, and in the ACTIVE control (11), which E3 does not touch. So the texture does not originate with E3. E3 removes the broad miss that hid it, and adds to it: see photoMottling. Both web columns lack native's dark contour.

Photo, 2x small footprint: the case G1 called mixed. Native's body is a smooth, low-contrast gradient from pink through lavender to grey-blue. Pre-W41 already shows more local colour structure than native. Now (E3) makes it more saturated: a hot-pink streak in the centre, salmon at the left, cyan-green at the right. The body reads more variegated than native, and a brighter central patch appears in the ΔE. Here E3 moves the body away from native: 42% of moved pixels are closer; the moved-region ΔE goes 0.0200 -> 0.0247; the broad chroma miss 0.0149 -> 0.0192. The body mean is close to native (211.7/167.5/201.7 against 210.8/169.0/201.7). What is worse is the local placement and amplitude of the colour.

Photo, 2x, same footprint as 1. It reads like the 1x cell. Pre-W41 is washed out, with a broad bright residual on the right and along the top. Now is saturated and much closer in hue and level (88% of moved pixels closer). Its body shows blotches at the backdrop's period: a darker purple patch top left, an olive-yellow patch bottom right. Its ΔE is a cellular pattern across the whole body. Both web ΔE panels also carry a faint fine diagonal hatch, and a bright band along the bottom inside edge.

Checkerboard, 1x: where L1 fails. Native's body is nearly flat mid-light grey (mean 189). The squares survive only as faint soft blobs. Pre-W41's body mean is 190, within about a code, but the checker shows clearly through the glass as a softened pattern. Near the rounded ends the squares' columns bend into curves (lens refraction); native shows none of that. Now (E3) keeps the same see-through checker and bent ends, and lifts the whole body to 212, about 22 codes lighter than native. Its ΔE is bright over the whole interior. The backdrop is achromatic, so there is no colour mottling here. The E3 failure is level; the visible checker and bent ends predate E3.

Impulse, 2x. Native: a flat grey body (133). The impulses under it show only as very faint, wide, soft blobs. Pre-W41: a uniformly lighter body (141). Now: the interior level matches native (134), and the flat grey ΔE is gone. But the three impulses under the body now show as clearly brighter halos than native's (at the centre and both ends), plus a bright sliver at the bottom edge centre. E3 improves the level and makes the impulse leakage more visible.

Light solid, 1x. The three bodies look identical by eye. E3 moves the body by one code (pre 235/235/238, now 234/234/239, native 235/235/239). Nearly every moved pixel (99.4%) is marginally farther from native (moved-region ΔE 0.0017 -> 0.0033), a difference far below what the eye sees. Native's thin grey contour is absent from both web columns.

Chromatic solid, 1x, E3's own domain. Pre-W41's body is a pale lavender (222/126/255) where native's is hot magenta-pink (255/101/255). Now matches native to one code (255/102/255), and the interior ΔE is black. The only residual is a thin outline where native has a slightly darker magenta contour at the edge.

Dark solid, 2x. Interiors are identical to native in both web columns. The seal moved only a thin ring of about 800 pixels at the rim, with no visible change. The rim outline in both ΔE panels is the missing contour.

Photo capsule under an orange tint, 1x. Native's body keeps the photo's hue under the tint, pinkish at the left and greenish at the right. Both web bodies are near-neutral grey (about 169/169/169 mean against native 151/164/159), with the same large ΔE. E3 barely changes this cell: tint displaces the body in both columns. This tinted-body gap is pre-existing and unrelated to E3.

Photo toolbar group, 1x. Pre-W41 washes the right-hand (green) member to grey-green, which shows as a large ΔE on that member. Now gives all three members native's saturation; the green member reads like native's. Each member keeps some mottled interior patches, and all lack native's contour ring.

Active control, photo rrect-md, 1x: byte-identical between pre-W41 and now, as required (all 122 active cells are). Its own active-pose gaps remain: a washed-out body, a bright residual on the right and at the edges, and the outer shadow below the glass. It also shows the cellular backdrop-period texture in its ΔE, without E3.

W39 uniform colour, light inactive, 1x. Pre-W41's body is visibly lighter and greyer than native; its ΔE interior is flat grey. Now matches native's level and olive hue: the interior ΔE is black even at an extra 4x gain (ΔE x 32). Both web columns lack native's dark contour just outside the path, so both show the same bright outline.

W39 vertical grey gradient, light inactive, 1x. Pre-W41 shows horizontal bands across the body (visible at ΔE x 8). Now removes most of them; at ΔE x 32 a faint banded residual remains in the upper half, plus a thin line across the middle. The contour is missing on both columns.

Checkerboard, 2x. Native at 2x lets a little more of the checker through than at 1x (soft blobs). Pre-W41 is close in level, and its ΔE is dark with fine ring structure. Now lifts the whole body (212 against 191), so its ΔE is mid-grey over the whole interior with the checker imprinted. Same reading as example 4.

Impulse, 1x. Pre-W41 leaks a small, sharp bright core at each impulse under the body, in a uniformly lighter body (141 against 133). Now matches the level (135), but widens those cores into larger, brighter halos with bright centres, most visible at the two ends. Native shows only faint soft blobs.

High-contrast text, 1x. Native's body dissolves the bars almost completely: a soft grey mass over the bar region, faint banding, and wide soft lobes at the ragged bar ends on the right. Pre-W41 keeps the individual bars clearly visible as grey stripes through the body. At the left edge the bars wrap into U-shaped curves (refraction); native shows none. Its level over the bar region is close to native (body mean 209.6 against 208.5). Now keeps the visible bars and the bent ends, and lightens the whole bar region (223). The ΔE over the left two thirds becomes a bright field with the bars imprinted.

High-contrast text, 2x. At 2x the bars are dissolved in all three columns. Pre-W41 is close to native over the bar region (dark ΔE); the wavy lobes at the right-hand bar ends are sharper than native's. Now lifts the bar region uniformly (222.7 against 208.2 body mean), so the ΔE there is a flat mid-grey. Same level reading as 17 and the checkerboard.

photoMottling.question: Is G1's mottling (E3 turning texture-period luma into chroma mottling, §5.192 §20) present on the shipped canonical photo cells?
photoMottling.observation: Yes, on every untinted light-inactive photo cell viewed (1, 2, 3, 10): the now body carries blotchy colour patches at the backdrop's period, and native's body is smoother. Two further observations qualify it. (a) The texture predates E3. Pre-W41's ΔE shows the same cellular pattern wherever its broad band does not swamp it, and so does the active control, which E3 does not touch. (b) E3 amplifies it. Measured on the body's own colour (texture.py: OKLab a/b residual after removing a local box mean, over the pixels the seal moved, eroded away from the rim), the fine chroma is higher in the now column than in pre-W41 on all 10 untinted photo inactive cells: by a factor of 1.14-1.24 at radius 6 px (1x; 12 px at 2x), and 1.06-1.27 across radii 3, 12 and 24. Pre-W41 was already 1.4-2.7x native at radius 6. E3 leaves the fully tinted photo capsules unchanged (tint displaces the body).
photoMottling.whereCloser: The broad level and hue: the broad (box-mean) chroma miss drops on 9 of the 10 untinted photo cells, e.g. 1x rrect-md 0.0357 -> 0.0106 and 2x rrect-md 0.0354 -> 0.0143, but only barely on the 1x small rrect (0.0153 -> 0.0142). It rises on the 2x small rrect (0.0149 -> 0.0192). On the moved pixels, now is nearer native on 9 of 10 cells in the moved-region mean; the exception is the 2x rrect-sm.

structuredAchromaticBackdrops.observation: On black-and-white structure, E3 lifts the body level while leaving the structure. Mean body codes, native / pre-W41 / now: checkerboard rrect-md 1x 189 / 190 / 212, 2x 191 / 190 / 212; checkerboard-4 188 / 191 / 212; checkerboard-8 189 / 190 / 212; hc-text lg 1x 208.5 / 209.6 / 223; hc-text-7 201 / 203 / 220. Now is farther from native than pre-W41 in the moved-region mean on 21 of the 22 untinted inactive black-and-white checkerboard cells (all periods 4, 8, 16, 32, 64; the exception is the 2x rrect-sm), all 4 tinted checkerboard capsules, and all 6 hc-text cells. On the low-contrast checkerboard-lc16 (128/229), both columns are within about five codes of native, and now is slightly closer on 3 of 4. These cells carry no chroma, so no colour mottling is involved.
structuredAchromaticBackdrops.preExistingOnTheseCells: Independently of E3, both web columns let far more of the backdrop's structure through the body than native does: native dissolves the 16 px checker and the 1x text bars almost completely. Near the rounded ends, the web columns bend that structure into curves (checker columns, U-shaped bar ends); native shows no such curves. That is the blur/lens gap, and E3 does not touch it.
structuredAchromaticBackdrops.levelsNote: Plain arithmetic for the next wave, not a finding. The sealed E3 neutral ordinates are 150,157,164,171,178,188,197 at encoded levels 40..150, and bodyE3Encoded extends the last segment linearly above 150 (0.41 per code). At the checkerboard's linear-light mean (encoded about 188) that line gives about 212, which is what now draws. The one uniform anchor above 150 on this bed, light-solid (242), lands on that line within a code of native (234 against 235). Native's checkerboard body (189) equals what the same line gives at 128, the encoded-space mean of black and white. hc-text does not fit that reading, though: its encoded mean is about 146, which the line maps to about 195, while native reads 208.5. The sheets cannot separate a spatial law from an unanchored stretch of the neutral curve between 150 and 242; no uniform grey native lies in that stretch on either bed.

impulse: Level closer on all 8 untinted and both tinted impulse cells (e.g. rrect-md 141 -> 135 against native 133; rrect-lg 107 -> 137 against 133). But the bright impulses under the body show as wider, brighter halos than in native or pre-W41 (examples 5 and 16). The same pattern appears on the photo: a broad level fix that amplifies local structure.
uniformBodies: The uniform bodies inside the claim close. On the mid-chroma solid (255/102/255 against native 255/101/255, from 222/126/255), the mid-dark solid (163 against 163, from 167), W39 uniform colour (13) and gradient (14), now matches native to about a code. On the light solid, E3 moves the body one code away (every moved pixel slightly farther, invisible by eye). The dark solid is unchanged in its interior.
controls: All 122 active-pose canonical cells are byte-identical between pre-W41 and now. Of the 86 light-inactive cells, the seal left 3 byte-identical: tinted capsules over the light solid (1x, 2x) and the dark solid (1x). On W39, 402 active and dark cells are unmoved and all 134 light-inactive cells moved.
gapsBothColumnsShare: Native's dark contour just outside the path is absent in both web columns on every example: the bright outline in every ΔE panel. The seal does not change it.
The web columns pass more backdrop structure through the body than native (checkerboard, hc-text at 1x, impulse cores) and bend it near the rounded ends. E3 does not change this.
Photo bodies under a full tint are near-neutral grey in both web columns, where native keeps the backdrop's hue.

Now-only recorded cell photo__rrect-md__inactive-pressed (1x, scratch canonical-1): the web draws a bright white press glow at the centre of the body; native shows none in the inactive pressed state. There is no pre-W41 column there.
distancesMeaning: Diagnostic only, not a referee. distances: OKLab ΔE to native over the whole frame, and over the moved pixels (every pixel whose RGBA differs between pre-W41 and now); closerFraction is the share of moved pixels where now is nearer native. body-texture: the same moved pixels eroded by 4 px (8 at 2x), with fine structure and broad miss split at the named box radius.
limitations: Seventeen examples were viewed, not every sheet. The distances and texture numbers cover all 86 rendered light-inactive cells; the eye does not.
RT, IC and CSS were not captured in G2; there is no accessibility or CSS-tier reading here.
The four examples 15-18 were added at the owner's request after the stop, from referee failures, before any canonical pixel was viewed in this gate.
